verse.verse_2: These are the verses of the Book that makes things clear.
verse.verse_3: It may be that you will destroy yourself with grief because they will not believe.
verse.verse_4: But if We had so willed, We could have sent down to them a sign from the heavens so that their heads would be bowed down before it in utter humility.
verse.verse_5: Whenever there comes to them any fresh warning from the Merciful, they always turn their backs on it:
verse.verse_6: they have indeed rejected the message. But the truth of what they laughed to scorn will dawn upon them before long.
verse.verse_7: Do they not see the earth, and what beneficial kinds of things We have caused to grow in it?
verse.verse_8: Surely in this there is a sign, yet most of them would not believe:
verse.verse_9: truly, your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_10: When your Lord called out to Moses, saying, "Go to the wrongdoing people,
verse.verse_11: the people of Pharaoh, will they not fear God?
verse.verse_12: Moses replied, "My Lord, I fear they will reject me,
verse.verse_13: and "my breast is straitened and my tongue is not fluent; so send Aaron as well;
verse.verse_14: besides, they accuse me of a crime, and I fear that they may put me to death."
verse.verse_15: God said, "Indeed not; go both of you with Our signs, We shall be with you, listening [to your call].
verse.verse_16: Go to Pharaoh, both of you, and say, 'We are messengers from the Lord of the Worlds:
verse.verse_17: let the Children of Israel go with us!'"
verse.verse_18: Pharaoh said to Moses, "Did we not bring you up among us as a child? And you spent several years of your life with us.
verse.verse_19: Yet you committed the deed you did, surely you are one of the ingrates."
verse.verse_20: Moses replied, "I did that when I was one of the misguided,
verse.verse_21: and I fled from you because I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers.
verse.verse_22: And this is the favour with which you taunt me -- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
verse.verse_23: Pharaoh said, "What is this: Lord of the Universe?"
verse.verse_24: Moses said, "Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if only you would be convinced."
verse.verse_25: Pharaoh said to those around him, "Did you hear?"
verse.verse_26: Moses went on, "He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers."
verse.verse_27: Pharaoh said, "This messenger who has been sent to you is surely possessed!"
verse.verse_28: Moses said, "He is the Lord of the East and the West, and all that lies between them, if only you could understand."
verse.verse_29: Pharaoh said, "If you take any deity other than myself, I will throw you into prison,"
verse.verse_30: and Moses asked, "Even if I show you a clear sign?"
verse.verse_31: Pharaoh said, "Show it then, if you are telling the truth!"
verse.verse_32: So Moses threw down his staff and suddenly it appeared as a serpent, plainly visible.
verse.verse_33: And he drew out his hand, and it appeared [shining] white to the beholders.
verse.verse_34: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, "Surely this man is a skilful sorcerer.
verse.verse_35: Who wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery. Now what do you advise?"
verse.verse_36: They said, "Let him and his brother wait a while, and send heralds into the cities,
verse.verse_37: who shall bring to you every skilful sorcerer."
verse.verse_38: So the sorcerers were gathered on the appointed day
verse.verse_39: and the people were told, "Will you also gather together,
verse.verse_40: so that we may follow the magicians, if they be the winners."
verse.verse_41: When the magicians came, they asked Pharaoh, "Shall we have a reward, if we are the winners?"
verse.verse_42: He replied, "Certainly, in that case you will join my inner circle."
verse.verse_43: Moses said to the magicians, "Throw down whatever you are going to throw."
verse.verse_44: So they cast down their ropes and staffs, and said, "By Pharaoh's honour, we shall surely win."
verse.verse_45: Then Moses threw down his staff, and it swallowed up all that they had conjured into being.
verse.verse_47: saying, "We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
verse.verse_48: the Lord of Moses and Aaron."
verse.verse_49: Pharaoh said, "Have you come to believe in him, before I have given you permission? He is surely your master who has taught you magic. But you shall see. I will cut off your hands and feet on alternate sides and crucify you all."
verse.verse_50: They said, "There is no harm. To our Lord we shall return.
verse.verse_51: We hope our Lord will forgive us, as we are the first of the believers."
verse.verse_52: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, saying, "Set forth with My servants, in the night, for you will surely be pursued."
verse.verse_53: And Pharaoh sent forth heralds to all the cities.
verse.verse_54: "These," they said, "are only a small band,
verse.verse_56: we are a large and watchful force."
verse.verse_57: So We made them leave their gardens and springs,
verse.verse_58: their treasures and their noble dwellings --
verse.verse_59: and We made the Children of Israel inheritors of these bounties.
verse.verse_60: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,
verse.verse_61: and when the two groups saw each other, Moses' companions said, "We are sure to be overtaken."
verse.verse_62: Moses replied, "No, My Lord is with me, and He will guide me."
verse.verse_63: Then We bade Moses strike the sea with his staff. And it parted, and each part was like a huge mountain.
verse.verse_64: In the meantime We made the others approach that place.
verse.verse_65: We delivered Moses and all those who were with him,
verse.verse_67: Surely in that there is a sign; yet most of them do not believe:
verse.verse_68: truly, your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_69: Tell them the story of Abraham,
verse.verse_70: when he asked his father and his people, "What is that which you worship?"
verse.verse_71: They said, "We worship idols and will continue to cling to them."
verse.verse_72: He asked, "Do they hear you when you call to them?
verse.verse_73: Do they help or harm you?"
verse.verse_74: They replied, "But we found our fathers doing the same."
verse.verse_75: Abraham said, "Have you really thought about what you have been worshipping,
verse.verse_77: they are all my enemies, not so the Lord of the Universe,
verse.verse_78: who created me. It is He who guides me;
verse.verse_79: He who gives me food and drink;
verse.verse_80: He who cures me when I am ill;
verse.verse_81: He who will cause me to die and bring me back to life;
verse.verse_82: and He who will, I hope, forgive me my faults on the Day of the Judgement.
verse.verse_83: My Lord, bestow wisdom upon me; unite me with the righteous;
verse.verse_84: give me a good name among later generations;
verse.verse_85: and make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;
verse.verse_86: and forgive my father; for he is one of the misguided;
verse.verse_87: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected,
verse.verse_88: the Day when wealth and sons will be of no avail,
verse.verse_89: and when he alone will be saved who comes to God with a sound heart."
verse.verse_90: When Paradise shall be brought near to the God-fearing
verse.verse_91: and Hell shall be revealed to the misguided,
verse.verse_92: they will be asked, "Where are those whom you worshipped
verse.verse_93: besides God? Can they help you or even help themselves?"
verse.verse_94: Then they will be thrown headlong into Hell, both they and the misguided ones,
verse.verse_96: They will dispute between themselves therein, and will say,
verse.verse_98: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Universe.
verse.verse_99: It was the evildoers who led us astray,
verse.verse_100: and we have no intercessors now,
verse.verse_102: If we could only return to the world and be among the believers."
verse.verse_103: There is certainly a sign in that, but most of them would not believe:
verse.verse_104: surely, your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_105: The people of Noah also rejected the messengers.
verse.verse_106: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you have no fear of God?
verse.verse_107: I am a trustworthy messenger for you:
verse.verse_109: I ask of you no recompense for it, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Universe,
verse.verse_110: so fear God and obey me."
verse.verse_111: They replied, "Are we to believe in you when your followers are but the lowest of the low?"
verse.verse_112: He said, "What knowledge do I have of their doings?
verse.verse_113: My Lord alone can bring them to account, if only you could understand,
verse.verse_114: I am not going to drive away any believers.
verse.verse_115: I am only a plain warner."
verse.verse_116: They said, "Noah, if you do not desist, you will be stoned."
verse.verse_117: Noah said, "My Lord, my people have rejected me,
verse.verse_118: therefore, judge decisively between me and them; and save me and the believers who are with me."
verse.verse_119: So We saved him, and those who were with him in the laden ark,
verse.verse_121: There is certainly a sign in that; but most of them do not believe:
verse.verse_122: surely your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_123: The people of 'Ad, too, rejected the messengers.
verse.verse_124: Their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear God?
verse.verse_125: I am a trustworthy messenger for you:
verse.verse_126: fear God, then, and obey me.
verse.verse_127: I ask no recompense of you; my reward is only with the Lord of the Universe.
verse.verse_128: Do you build monuments on every high place in vanity,
verse.verse_129: and erect castles hoping that you will live forever.
verse.verse_130: When you lay hands upon anyone, you do so as tyrants.
verse.verse_131: So fear God, and obey me;
verse.verse_132: fear Him who has aided you with all that you know --
verse.verse_133: He has bestowed on you cattle, and sons,
verse.verse_135: indeed, I fear for you the torment of an awful day."
verse.verse_136: They replied, "It makes no difference to us whether you preach or do not preach,
verse.verse_137: this is nothing but a habit of the ancients:
verse.verse_138: and we shall not be punished."
verse.verse_139: So they rejected him; and We destroyed them. There is certainly a sign in that; but most of them would not believe.
verse.verse_140: Surely your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_141: The tribe of Thamud also rejected the messengers.
verse.verse_142: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear God?
verse.verse_143: Truly, I am a trustworthy messenger for you,
verse.verse_144: so fear God and obey me.
verse.verse_145: For this I demand no recompense from you; my reward is only with the Lord of the Universe.
verse.verse_146: Do you think that you will be left secure [forever] --
verse.verse_147: in the midst of gardens and fountains,
verse.verse_148: and cornfields, and palm-trees laden with fruit --
verse.verse_149: hewing out houses in the mountains and taking pride in your skill?
verse.verse_150: So fear God and obey me:
verse.verse_151: do not obey the bidding of those who are given to excesses,
verse.verse_152: those who spread corruption in the land instead of putting things right."
verse.verse_154: You are only a human being like ourselves. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth."
verse.verse_155: He said, "Here is a she-camel. She shall have her turn of drinking, as you have yours, each on an appointed day,
verse.verse_156: so do her no harm, or the punishment of an awful day will befall you."
verse.verse_157: Yet they hamstrung her, and then they became regretful:
verse.verse_158: so the punishment came down upon them. Surely in that there is a sign, but most of them would not believe.
verse.verse_159: Your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_160: Then the people of Lot rejected the messengers.
verse.verse_161: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear God?
verse.verse_162: I am a trustworthy messenger to you:
verse.verse_163: so fear God and obey me.
verse.verse_164: I ask of you no recompense for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the Universe.
verse.verse_165: Do you, of all people, approach males,
verse.verse_166: and leave your wives whom your Lord has created for you? You are a people who transgress all bounds."
verse.verse_167: They said, "If you do not desist, Lot, you will surely be banished."
verse.verse_168: He said, "I am one of those who abhors your ways.
verse.verse_169: My Lord, save me and my family from their evil doings."
verse.verse_170: We saved him and all of his family,
verse.verse_171: except for an old woman who stayed behind,
verse.verse_172: then We totally destroyed the rest,
verse.verse_173: and We poured a rain [of destruction] down upon them -- and how evil was the rain which fell on those who were forewarned.
verse.verse_174: Surely in this there is a sign: but most of them would not believe:
verse.verse_175: your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_176: The dwellers of the forest also rejected the messengers.
verse.verse_177: Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear God?
verse.verse_178: I am a trustworthy messenger to you:
verse.verse_179: so fear God, and obey me.
verse.verse_180: I ask of you no recompense for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the Universe.
verse.verse_181: Give full measure, and cause no loss to others.
verse.verse_183: do not defraud people of what is rightfully theirs; and do not spread corruption in the land.
verse.verse_184: Fear Him who created you and those who have gone before you."
verse.verse_186: You are only a human being like ourselves. Indeed we think you are a liar.
verse.verse_187: So cause a fragment of the sky to fall on us, if you are truthful."
verse.verse_188: He said, "My Lord has full knowledge of all your actions."
verse.verse_189: They rejected him, and then had to suffer the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom. That was indeed the punishment of an awful day.
verse.verse_190: Surely, in this is indeed a sign; but most of them would not believe:
verse.verse_191: your Lord is the Mighty One, the Merciful.
verse.verse_192: This surely is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe:
verse.verse_193: the Faithful Spirit has brought it down
verse.verse_194: into your heart, so that you may be a warner,
verse.verse_196: Surely, it is foretold in the ancient scriptures.
verse.verse_197: Is it not evidence enough for them that the learned among the Children of Israel have recognized this [as true]?
verse.verse_198: Had We revealed it to any one of the non-Arabs,
verse.verse_199: and he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
verse.verse_200: We have thus caused denial of truth to enter into the hearts of the sinners:
verse.verse_201: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous punishment.
verse.verse_202: It will come upon them suddenly when they are not expecting it.
verse.verse_203: Then they will exclaim, "Could we have some respite?"
verse.verse_204: Do they want to hasten Our punishment?
verse.verse_205: Think! If We let them enjoy life for some years,
verse.verse_206: and then the promised punishment fell upon them,
verse.verse_207: of what avail would their past enjoyment be to them?
verse.verse_208: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,
verse.verse_209: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.
verse.verse_210: It was not the devils who brought down the Quran:
verse.verse_211: neither are they worthy of it, nor are they capable of it,
verse.verse_212: indeed they are debarred from overhearing it.
verse.verse_213: So do not call on any deity besides God, lest you incur His punishment.
verse.verse_215: and extend kindness and affection to those of the believers who follow you.
verse.verse_216: If they disobey you, say, "I bear no responsibility for what you do."
verse.verse_217: Put your trust in the Mighty One, the Merciful,
verse.verse_218: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer],
verse.verse_219: and sees your movements among those who prostrate themselves:
verse.verse_220: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verse.verse_221: Shall I tell you upon whom the devils descend?
verse.verse_222: They descend on every lying sinner,
verse.verse_223: who lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars.
verse.verse_224: And as for the poets -- it is the misled who follow them.
verse.verse_225: Do you not see how they wander aimlessly in every valley,
verse.verse_226: preaching what they do not practice.
verse.verse_227: Not so the true believers who do good works and remember God with fervour and defend themselves only after they are wronged. The wrongdoers will soon know how evil a turn their affairs will take.
